title: Soak at Chena Hot Springs in the snow
description: At Chena Hot Springs, you walk through cold air toward the outdoor rock lake and slip into naturally heated water. Steam rises while snow collects around the pool, making the contrast between your warm shoulders and the Alaskan night feel almost impossible. Stay for an unhurried soak, then head inside to warm up before the drive back.
teaser: Step from winter air into Chena’s steaming outdoor pool.
goodToKnow: Before you go, check hot-water suitability, pool access and slippery footing.
whyItMightDelightYou: Few experiences make cold and warmth feel so vivid at the same time.
